generatedBy: Driver Prediction Run 1 (Claude Fable 5) - standalone driver/nowcast lens; justification in agent/DriverPredictionRun1.md
method: Macro -> units sold -> dollars. High-signal external metrics published AFTER the companies last guided (19-21 May 2026) are mapped through explicit elasticity chains into each target metric. Every chain is calibrated on the latest closed quarter where drivers and outcome are both known; the unexplained residual carries forward at HALF weight. No management guidance or steers are used as the primary input except where flagged as fallback. Compare against agent/fable-research-forecast.json (anchor lens) after actuals print.

metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.chain: Guide-independent peer read-through: TXN June-qtr analog +26% y/y (2 of ADI's 3 fiscal months overlap) and TXN Sept-qtr guide +8.1% q/q vs ADI implied +7.6% - the cycle ran at/above the slope ADI assumed. Beat of +2.8% on 3,900 base, sigma 1.2pp.

metrics.label: Adjusted diluted EPS
metrics.chain: P&L flow-through of driver revenue: dRev q/q = 4,009-3,623 = +386; incremental adj op margin 65% (recent 2 qtrs ran ~80%, structural ~50%; half-shrunk to 65%) -> adj OI 1,774+251 = 2,025; nonop 57; tax 12.5% -> NI 1,722; / 490M shares = 3.51.

metrics.label: Adjusted gross margin
metrics.chain: Driver lens adds little: utilization already maxed (physical constraint), mix tailwind from data center (above corp-avg GM) growing fastest. Direction +, magnitude unresolvable from external data; carries the anchor-lens 72.9.

metrics.label: Net fees
metrics.chain: Fiscal year ended 30 Jun - nothing to nowcast. The value is built entirely from disclosed actuals (H1 453.3 + Q3 at -7% + Q4 at -4%, minus c.15 from the six disposed countries), which is the most driver-pure number in either file: zero management opinion in it.

metrics.label: Pre-exceptional basic EPS
metrics.chain: Mechanical from op profit via guided finance charge (13) and ETR (45%): no external driver can improve on closed-year arithmetic. Carried.

metrics.label: Pre-exceptional operating profit
metrics.chain: Company steer ('top of 37.0-46.0 range') given after the year closed. External drivers (UK/DE vacancy indices) are strictly older information than the steer; carried.

metrics.label: Worldwide net sales and revenues
metrics.chain: Segment unit chains on Q3-25 bases: PPA 4,273 x (0.55x(-11) units + 0.45x(-1) RoW + 1.75 price + 2.5 FX - 2.55 Q2-residual/2) = 4,047. SAT 3,025 x (0.7x(-10) units + 0.3x(+1) + 1.75 + 2.0 + 7.9 Q2-residual/2 [production normalization]) = 3,175. C&F 3,059 x (+4 industry units + 1.75 + 2.0 + 10.6 Q2-residual/2) = 3,622. Equipment 10,844 + financial services & other 1,630 (6-qtr range 1,590-1,660) = 12,474.

metrics.label: Diluted EPS (GAAP)
metrics.chain: Segment op profits from driver sales x margins (PPA 12.6%, SAT 16.0% [Q3-25 level], C&F 11.0%) = 513+508+398 = 1,419; NI = (1,419 x 0.755 tax + 215 FinSvcs) x 1.05 corporate/pension multiplier (calibrated 1.03-1.085 over 4 qtrs) = 1,350; / 269.8M shares = 5.00.

metrics.label: Production & Precision Ag operating profit
metrics.chain: AEM units chain (Jul tractors -10.9, combines -5.3, Jun combines ~+1, Apr R3M -14/-24) -> PPA sales 4,047 x 12.6% margin (H1 11.0%, best cost comps reserved for Q4) = 513. Produced by forecast/drivers.py.

metrics.label: Net sales
metrics.chain: Q2-25 base 45,283 x (1 + 1.9 driver comps + 3.3 GMS inorganic [Q1-observed total-vs-comp gap] + 0.3 new stores) = 47,774.

metrics.label: Adjusted diluted EPS
metrics.chain: Sales-to-EPS wedge calibrated on Q1 FY26 (sales +4.8% vs adj EPS -3.7% = -8.5pp wedge from GMS dilution/interest/mix), carried at half weight: EPS growth = +5.5 - 4.25 = +1.25% -> 4.68 x 1.0125 = 4.74.

metrics.label: Comparable sales, total company
metrics.chain: Census NAICS 444 nowcast: quarter-window category +5.2% y/y (Jul +5.9 accelerating vs +4.6 YTD) minus 3.3pp category-to-comp wedge calibrated on Q1 (category +3.9 vs HD comps +0.6). Produced by forecast/drivers.py.
